title: Nine Mends and Eleven Years
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：bike　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bike 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my brother borrowed ① a bike he was too small for and rode it for eleven years, and my father said the borrowing was the whole of the ownership. The ② bike, meaning the machine and not the riding, was mended nine times and was never once clean; a bike, he said, is the only object that belongs to whoever is holding it.

Every ③ bike in that street had been stolen at least once, and the ④ bike with the bent frame, meaning the one nobody wanted and not either of those, was the only one that was never locked. A bike, my grandmother said, is nine parts luck and one part a lock you can be bothered with; my brother said the luck is the part they talk about.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ bike was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the riding and not the machine. The ⑥ bike, meaning the hours on the road and not any of that, is the only thing in a childhood that nobody remembers learning; a bike, she said, is either something you borrow or the only word that means both a machine and an afternoon. He said the afternoon is the part that lasts.

By 1971 the ⑦ bike had become a photograph in a shop window, and the window had become an argument about the price. The ⑧ bike of the whole thing, my brother wrote in May, was nine mends and eleven years of borrowing; a bike, he said, is either the thing with the bent frame or the reason you learned the back roads. She said the back roads were the part nobody taught him.

The ⑨ bike I remember is the one with the bent frame, which was given away in 1974 and was still being ridden in 1979. A ⑩ bike, my mother said in 1981, is the only machine that improves by being lent; every bike, she said, is an afternoon that has agreed to look like a machine. He said the afternoon was the real part.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 自行车（指那台机器，与骑行相对）
C. 固定搭配：borrow a bike 借一辆自行车
D. n. 自行车（指那条街上每一辆）
E. n. 自行车（指车架弯了那一辆）
F. n. 骑车（指那个下午／骑行这件事）
G. n. 骑行（抽象：在路上耗掉的那些小时）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

answers.why: borrow a bike 意为“借一辆自行车”，1957 年哥哥借了一辆对他来说太大的自行车，骑了十一年。
bike 意为“自行车”，指那台机器而不是骑行，它修了九次，从没干净过一次。
bike 指那条街上每一辆自行车，那条街上每一辆都至少被偷过一次。
bike 指车架弯了那一辆（没人要的那一辆），是唯一从不上锁的。
bike 意为“骑车”，指那个下午骑行这件事，母亲说 bike 就是那个下午的全部。
bike 为抽象用法，指在路上耗掉的那些小时，是童年里唯一没人记得自己是怎样学会的东西。
bike 意为“自行车”，到 1971 年这个 bike 成了商店橱窗里的一张照片。
bike 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，哥哥五月写道，整件事权衡下来是九次修理和十一年的借用。
bike 意为“自行车”，我记得的是车架弯了那一辆，1974 年被送掉，1979 年还有人在骑。
bike 为抽象总称，母亲说自行车是唯一会因为被借出去而变好的机器。
